The '''16th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in [[film]] for [[1958 in film|1958]] films, were held on March 5, 1959.

==Winners and nominees==

===Film===

====[[Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Drama|Best Film - Drama]]====
''' ''[[The Defiant Ones]]'''''
*''[[Cat on a Hot Tin Roof (1958 film)|Cat on a Hot Tin Roof]]''
*''[[Home Before Dark (film)|Home Before Dark]]''
*''[[I Want to Live!]]''
*''[[Separate Tables (film)|Separate Tables]]''

''' ''[[Auntie Mame (film)|Auntie Mame]]'''''
*''[[Bell, Book and Candle (film)|Bell, Book and Candle]]''
*''[[Indiscreet (1958 film)|Indiscreet]]''
*''[[Me and the Colonel]]''
*''[[The Perfect Furlough]]''

''' ''[[Gigi (1958 film)|Gigi]]'''''
*''[[Damn Yankees (film)|Damn Yankees]]''
*''[[Tom Thumb (film)|Tom Thumb]]''
